message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: E2E Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ trunk, develop ]

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          tools: composer

      - name: Cache Composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        run: composer install --no-dev --no-progress --prefer-dist

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci --force

      - name: Build plugin assets
        run: npm run build

      - name: Install Playwright Chromium
        run: npx playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Start wp-env
        run: npx wp-env start

      - name: Run E2E tests
        env:
          WP_USERNAME: admin
          WP_PASSWORD: password
        run: npm run test:e2e

      - name: Stop wp-env
        if: always()
        run: npx wp-env stop

      - name: Upload test artifacts
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-test-results
          path: |
            test-results/
            playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7",
  "rationale": "The workflow already caches npm dependencies via setup-node's built-in cache, but Composer dependencies are downloaded on every run without caching. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (literature) and P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE experiment (measured) both support caching dependency downloads keyed by lockfile hashes. Adding a cache step for ~/.composer/cache keyed on composer.lock preserves all required checks, matches the existing npm caching approach, and addresses repeated dependency fetching measurable in this PHP/Node.js project. No contraindications apply: Composer cache content is immutable downloaded packages, and no equivalent cache exists for Composer.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
